title: VMware vCenter Directory Service authentication bypass CVE-2026-123890
summary: Broadcom issued VMSA-2026-0009 on November 19 for a critical 9.8-rated authentication bypass in VMware vCenter Directory Service. It provides fixed versions for supported releases and no workaround. Separate Google/Mandiant reporting describes suspected exploitation before disclosure; organizations must patch exposed vCenter management systems.
fix: Broadcom published fixed versions including vCenter 8.0 U3m, 9.0.2.0200 and 9.1.1.0200; follow the response matrix for each product. No workaround for CVE-2026-123890.

rootCause.summary: Authentication bypass in VMware Directory Service permitting network-reachable attackers to bypass vCenter authentication.

history.summary: Broadcom disclosed five VMware vulnerabilities including the critical vCenter authentication bypass CVE-2026-123890, rated 9.8. A network-reachable attacker may obtain unauthorized access.
Broadcom published supported product fixes and reported no workaround for the vCenter authentication bypass. Patch deployment and full incident scope are not established.
